ATL.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Young core, roster crunch. Expiring contracts offer future flexibility.

BOS.note: Tatum returns from Achilles. Under tax, resetting repeater penalties. Large trade exception. Potential buyer.

BKN.note: Significant cap space, young core. Not hard-capped. Buyers in free agency.

CHA.note: Coby White returned from calf injury. Knueppel, Grant Williams out with hamstrings. Young team.

CHI.note: Cap space, under aprons. Flexible for trades/signings. Some potentially bad contracts.

CLE.note: Multiple injuries to rotation players (Allen, Watson, Tyson, Tomlin, Diop). Strong core.

DET.note: Young core, under tax/aprons, cap flexibility, tradeable contracts. Potential buyers at deadline.

IND.note: Haliburton returns healthy. Minimal luxury tax overage.

MIA.note: Acquired Giannis, high expectations. Under both aprons, some tradeable contracts. Minor injuries.

MIL.note: Under tax/aprons, good flexibility. Building for future.

NYK.note: Hard-capped at second apron. Championship roster, but minimal flexibility.

ORL.note: Over first apron, under second. Young core, significant contracts. Several key injuries.

PHI.note: Over tax, under aprons. Core of Embiid, George, Maxey. Limited flexibility.

TOR.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Core of Barnes, Quickley, Barrett, Poeltl, Leonard. Young players.

WAS.note: Hard-capped at first apron. #1 pick AJ Dybantsa. Limited flexibility.

DAL.note: Luka Doncic era. Significant cap space under tax. Potential buyers.

DEN.note: Deep into second apron, repeater tax. Severely limited flexibility. Jokic extension looming.

GSW.note: Hard-capped at second apron. High payroll. Significant expiring contracts for future flexibility.

HOU.note: Deep roster with veteran and young talent. At tax line, under aprons. VanVleet's option is key.

LAC.note: Under all aprons, good financial situation. Trade exceptions. Focused on future.

LAL.note: Luka Doncic era. Massive cap space. Buyers in free agency/trades.

MEM.note: Significant cap space and trade exception. Hard-capped at first apron. Buyers for young talent.

MIN.note: Hard-capped at second apron. High payroll, deep into tax. Limited flexibility. Key injuries.

NOP.note: Under tax/aprons, some flexibility. Need roster changes. Poole's contract is a bad one.

OKC.note: Over first apron, high tax. Key injuries Williams, Wallace. Ownership pressure to cut costs.

PHX.note: Hard-capped at second apron. Limited flexibility, but some room for a move.

POR.note: Young core, cap flexibility, trade assets. Lillard returning from Achilles. Potential buyer.

SAC.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Need depth at guard/wing. May need to shed salaries.

SAS.note: Deep young core (Wemby, Vassell, Johnson). Under tax/aprons, good flexibility.

UTA.note: Under tax/aprons, good flexibility. Trade exceptions. Building for future.
